summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan closing both halves of the snapshot-artifact containment defect. Phase 1 lands demonstrated-RED regression cases in both existing suites; phases 2-4 run in parallel (scope the --no-revert untracked enumeration, add conditional :(exclude) entries to git-commit-phase.sh's fixed seed, register untracked-backup-*/ in the ephemeral runtime-file class with its three coupled generated surfaces); phase 5 deploys and confirms acceptance. Plan-time premise re-validation found this repository already ignores **/untracked-backup-*/ at the root while the incident repository does not, which reframes the class registration as a propagation fix.
